quandoUsar: Social-proof strip on a landing page: customers, integrations, or compatible tools passing in a continuous line.
When there are enough brands for one copy of the list to be wider than the section and none of them needs emphasis or a link.
quandoEvitar: Use `marquee` when the scrolling content is not a list of brands or when you need to control speed, direction, or vertical scrolling.
With few brands, prefer a static grid: if one copy of the list is narrower than the section, the loop does not close and a gap appears at the end.
If each logo needs to be a link or open a customer case, this block does not fit: items are only a symbol and a name, with no interaction.

teclado.acao: On the “Pause” or “Play” button, pause or resume the strip's motion.

acessibilidade: The strip is a named `role="region"`, the duplicated copy of the list is `aria-hidden`, and the symbols are decorative: each brand's name is real text.
The pause button has an `aria-label` that switches between pause and resume, and an `aria-live="polite"` region announces “Motion paused”.
The accessible names of the region and the button are hardcoded in English in the file (“Illustrative tool logos”, “Pause logo motion”); adjust them when you swap the brands.
movimento: The strip slides left in a continuous 39 s loop with a linear CSS animation; hovering over it or pressing the button freezes the motion where it is.
With “reduce motion” on, the animation is removed, the brands become a centered list that wraps onto lines, the duplicated copy disappears, and the pause button is hidden.
responsivo: A container query on the section (up to 639 px) stacks the title and description, reduces the type size, and brings the brands closer together.
desempenho: The motion is a single CSS `transform` animation on the strip, with no per-frame JavaScript; each symbol is painted as a CSS mask from the SVG URL, so use small files.
notasIA: Pass `brands` with `name` and `icon` (URL of a monochrome SVG, used as a mask); `color` paints the symbol in the `color` tone and `colorIcon` replaces the mask with a color image.
The default brands are abstract example shapes, not real logos; the loop duration is fixed at 39 s, so longer lists move faster.
`tone="mono"` draws everything in the text color; there is no `className` prop, and the block depends on `button`.
